deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
This commit (DSpark logprobs adaptive verification) lifts the SamplingParams restriction and makes the GPU spec-decode RejectionSampler (vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/rejection_sampler.py, used verbatim by Ascend's NPUModelRunner since it subclasses GPUModelRunner) pass the per-request boundaries as a DEVICE tensor (cu_num_logits.clone()) to the logprob computation, and adds a 5th field cu_num_generated_tokens_tensor to LogprobsTensors (vllm/v1/outputs.py). vllm-ascend patches those logprob entry points with NPU Triton implementations, so it must mirror the new data-flow:
1. vllm_ascend/worker/v2/sample/logprob.py::compute_topk_logprobs: widen signature from 'cu_num_logits: list[int] | None = None' to 'list[int] | torch.Tensor | None = None', and in the LogprobsTensors(...) construction (lines ~164-168) mirror upstream compute_topk_scores: set 'cu_num_generated_tokens=None if isinstance(cu_num_logits, torch.Tensor) else cu_num_logits' and 'cu_num_generated_tokens_tensor=cu_num_logits if isinstance(cu_num_logits, torch.Tensor) else None'. Otherwise the adaptive-verification device tensor lands in the list field, breaking downstream tolists()/slice_request() and corrupting per-request logprobs on NPU.
2. vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_triton.py: verify the patched symbol (compute_topk_logprobs, bound for rejection_sampler/sampler/prompt_logprob) is the one actually invoked from the inherited GPU RejectionSampler._get_logprobs_tensors once the vLLM version aligns, and that the NPU implementation is what receives the adaptive-verification tensor boundaries.
3. vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py::NPUModelRunner: confirm the inherited _verify_in_chunks/_get_logprobs_tensors path handles the single-chunk constraint added for adaptive verification (assert not self.enable_adaptive_verification in the chunking branch) and that cu_num_logits_np staying on the pre-compacted layout (already the case in Ascend prepare_inputs) is compatible.
4. vllm_ascend/worker/npu_input_batch.py and model_runner_v1.py (LogprobsTensors consumers via tolists()/RejectionSampler.parse_output): no 4-tuple unpacking exists, but confirm no assumptions about the NamedTuple field count; the new field is handled by shared upstream tolists()/to_cpu_nonblocking().
5. Add an e2e NPU test for DSpark with enable_adaptive_verification:true + num_logprobs set (previously rejected by the removed SamplingParams ValueError) to validate boundaries and logprob attachment.
deep_analysis.risk: Medium. Feature-gated: only triggers when DSpark adaptive (confidence-based) verification and output logprobs are used together. Without adaptation, the NPU logprob path stores the device-boundary tensor in cu_num_generated_tokens, so per-request logprobs slicing/attachment is wrong (or slice_request crashes), producing silent logprob corruption on NPU. The code delta itself is small and localized, but it interacts with Ascend's custom Triton sampling kernels and the patched rejection-sampler flow, and requires NPU hardware validation for a speculative-decoding + logprobs combination that was previously disallowed.

[Bugfix] Keep grid dims for XD-RoPE models on a prefix-cache hit (#53456)

Signed-off-by: Mikhail Kostryukov <mike@triptrack.net>
Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

affected_interfaces: NewRequestData.from_request (vllm.v1.core.sched.output) — new uses_xdrope kwarg must be forwarded by ascend custom schedulers; not passed in their overridden call sites
strip_covered_mm_data (vllm.multimodal.utils) — new uses_xdrope param controls whether XD-RoPE grid dims (image_grid_thw) survive prefix-cache-covered strips

vllm_ascend.core.dyntra_lb_scheduler.DyntraLBScheduler — schedule()/_make_new_request_data path calls NewRequestData.from_request at dyntra_lb_scheduler.py:1078 (V2) and :1087 (V1) without uses_xdrope
vllm_ascend.core.recompute_scheduler.RecomputeScheduler — from_request calls at recompute_scheduler.py:950 (V2) and :959 (V1) without uses_xdrope
vllm_ascend.core.scheduler_profiling_chunk.ProfilingChunkScheduler — from_request calls at scheduler_profiling_chunk.py:707 (V2) and :716 (V1) without uses_xdrope
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: Mirror the vLLM core fix in the three ascend custom schedulers that override the new-request-data construction. For each of vllm_ascend/core/dyntra_lb_scheduler.py (~line 1078), vllm_ascend/core/recompute_scheduler.py (~line 950), and vllm_ascend/core/scheduler_profiling_chunk.py (~line 707): (1) add `self.model_uses_xdrope = vllm_config.model_config.uses_xdrope` next to the existing `self.model_uses_mrope` init (property added by this commit in vllm/config/model.py:1846); (2) pass `uses_xdrope=self.model_uses_xdrope` to every `NewRequestData.from_request(...)` call in both the V2 (`req._all_token_ids`) and V1 branches. Note these call sites also omit `uses_mrope`, so while touching them, forward `uses_mrope=self.model_uses_mrope` as well to avoid the same M-RoPE grid-dims drop on prefix-cache hits. The default vLLM Scheduler/AsyncScheduler (and ascend ShortRequestFirstAsyncScheduler / BatchJobAwareScheduler, which subclass without overriding this section) pick up the fix automatically and need no change. Ensure the pinned vLLM version is bumped to include this commit so `NewRequestData.from_request` accepts the `uses_xdrope` kwarg; add/extend a test mirroring tests/v1/core/test_output.py::test_strip_covered_mm_data_xdrope and run an XD-RoPE (e.g. HunYuan-VL) prefix-cache-hit smoke test.
deep_analysis.risk: Low-medium. The new `uses_xdrope`/`uses_mrope` parameters default to False, so existing ascend calls compile and run without breakage — the failure mode is silent: XD-RoPE (and M-RoPE) grid dims keep being stripped on prefix-cache hits under DyntraLBScheduler/RecomputeScheduler/ProfilingChunkScheduler, reproducing the crash the upstream fix addresses. If vllm-ascend's pinned vLLM is not synced to this commit, passing `uses_xdrope` would raise TypeError, so version sync and code change must land together. Main risk is forgetting one of the three custom schedulers or the V1/V2 branches, leaving an intermittent per-request crash for XD-RoPE multimodal models.

commits.comment: （自动判定）仅涉及 tests / docs / CI / 平台特化代码变更，不影响 vllm-ascend。

Model Runner V2 新增 batch-sharded sampling 特性。在 TP 维度按 batch 分片采样：每个 rank 只采样自己拥有的请求子集，通过 all-to-all 交换 vocab 分片 logits，再 all-gather 合并采样结果。新增 ParallelConfig.enable_batch_sharded_sampling 配置和 CLI 参数，VllmConfig 增加校验逻辑（要求 V2 runner、TP>1、max_num_seqs>=TP、max_logprobs>=0、不支持 adaptive verification）。LogitsProcessor 新增 skip_gather 参数，Llama/Qwen3.5/DeepSeek-V4/MiniMaxM3/Inkling 等模型实现 compute_logits_local。GPUModelRunner 集成 BatchSharder，finish_requests 改为排序后释放 slot 以保证跨 rank 确定性。特性默认关闭，需模型实现 compute_logits_local 才能启用。测试覆盖路由数学、all-to-all 重组、grammar 分片、采样输出 gather 等。

ascend_impact.functionality: vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py 命中必然影响路径。GPUModelRunner 新增 batch_sharder 属性（默认 None）并修改 sample_tokens 流程。NPUModelRunnerV2 继承 GPUModelRunner，自动获得新属性，但特性默认关闭（enable_batch_sharded_sampling 默认 None→False），vllm-ascend 模型未实现 compute_logits_local，即使显式开启也会告警并回退到复制采样路径。finish_requests 改为排序后释放 slot，属于确定性行为修复，对 Ascend 兼容。LogitsProcessor.forward/_get_logits 新增 skip_gather 参数（默认 False），向后兼容；vllm-ascend 若覆写 LogitsProcessor 需注意新参数。ParallelConfig 新增字段不影响 AscendConfig 解析。
ascend_impact.testing: 无直接影响。vllm-ascend 的 NPUModelRunnerV2 测试不受影响，因为新特性默认关闭且 vllm-ascend 模型不实现 compute_logits_local。

commits.message:
[Model Runner V2] batch-sharded sample (#50465)

Signed-off-by: Giancarlo Delfin <gdelfin@inferact.ai>

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py::NPUModelRunnerV2 (inherits GPUModelRunner.sample_tokens, __init__ batch_sharder init, finish_requests sorted slot-free order)
vllm_ascend/worker/v2/input_batch.py::AscendInputBatch (dataclass consumed by new BatchSharder.shard_sampler_inputs via dataclasses.replace)
vllm_ascend/models/ (DeepseekV4, MiniMaxM3, DSpark, MTP, LlamaEagle3 compute_logits/... need compute_logits_local to opt in)
vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_triton.py (new triton kernels in vllm/v1/worker/gpu/sample/batch_shard.py are NOT patched for Ascend triton)
vllm_ascend/lora/ (LogitsProcessorWithLoRA now raises NotImplementedError when skip_gather=True)
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: This commit adds an opt-in feature (--enable-batch-sharded-sampling, defaults to False) plus one UNCONDITIONAL breaking interface change. 1) MANDATORY FIX (breaks on every forward once synced): upstream vllm/model_executor/layers/logits_processor.py LogitsProcessor.forward/_get_logits now take `skip_gather: bool = False`, and base forward always calls self._get_logits(hidden_states, lm_head, embedding_bias, skip_gather) with 4 positional args. AscendLogitsProcessor (vllm_ascend/ops/vocab_parallel_embedding.py, registered as the OOT 'LogitsProcessor' op) overrides _get_logits with the old 3-arg signature, so every model forward on Ascend will raise TypeError. Add `skip_gather: bool = False` to _get_logits, _get_logits_normal, _get_logits_lmheadtp and return the local (un-gathered, un-padded) logits before TP gather / vocab trim when skip_gather=True (mirror the upstream _get_logits). 2) Feature support (only when enabled): the new vllm/v1/worker/gpu/sample/batch_shard.py (BatchSharder.shard_sampler_inputs, all_to_all_logits via torch.distributed.all_to_all_single on get_tp_group().device_group, gather_sampler_output via tensor_model_parallel_all_gather) runs inside GPUModelRunner.sample_tokens that NPUModelRunnerV2 inherits; it uses 5 new triton kernels (_build_shard_plan_kernel, _pack_sampler_output_kernel, _unpack_gathered_output_kernel, _pack_logprobs_kernel, _unpack_logprobs_kernel) that patch_triton.py does not override - validate them on the Ascend triton backend, and confirm all_to_all_single/all_gather work on HCCL. 3) To make the feature usable on Ascend, add compute_logits_local() to vllm_ascend models (deepseek_v4/model.py, minimax_m3/minimax_m3.py, dspark.py, mtp.py, llama_eagle3_vwn.py); otherwise it silently disables with a warning since only upstream LlamaForCausalLM/Qwen3_5/DeepseekV4-nvidia/MiniMaxM3-nvidia/Inkling got compute_logits_local. 4) Verify AscendInputBatch (dataclass) survives dataclasses.replace in shard_sampler_inputs. 5) Note finish_requests now frees request slots in sorted(finished_req_ids) order (required for rank-ownership consistency); inherited by NPUModelRunnerV2 - keep slot assignment identical across TP ranks.
deep_analysis.risk: medium. The mandatory risk is a hard TypeError: once vllm-ascend syncs to this vLLM version, any model using AscendLogitsProcessor crashes on every logits computation because its _get_logits override lacks the new skip_gather param - this must be fixed before/with the sync and is not gated by the opt-in flag. The batch-shard feature itself is off by default (VllmConfig._validate_batch_sharded_sampling raises only when explicitly enabled), so default serving behavior is preserved, but if a user enables it on Ascend: (a) upstream-model paths could invoke compute_logits_local -> AscendLogitsProcessor.forward(skip_gather=True) and hit the signature bug, (b) the new triton kernels and all_to_all on HCCL are unverified, and (c) lm_head LoRA is rejected by design (NotImplementedError). NPU triton and HCCL all_to_all correctness/perf in the hot sampling path needs dedicated validation.
